name: @zkp2p/plugin-peer-cash
description: Peer Cash offramp actions for elizaOS agents: estimate, cash out Base USDC to Venmo, Revolut, Wise, Zelle, and more at the live oracle market rate, then track, withdraw, and top up orders.
author: Peer (https://peer.xyz)

scripts.test: bun run test:component && bun run test:e2e

PEER_CASH_ENVIRONMENT.description: Peer Cash environment: production, preproduction, or staging. Selects contracts, curator, and indexer.

PEER_CASH_REFERRAL_CODE.description: Optional six character Peer referral code. Stamped as ERC-8021 attribution on every cash-out deposit; when that liquidity fills, Curator pays the code owner a 50 bps integration share.

PEER_CASH_REFERRER.description: Optional analytics-only ERC-8021 attribution code (for example acme-app). Carries no fee share.

PEER_CASH_RPC_URL.description: Optional Base RPC URL override for oracle and order reads. Defaults to the public Base RPC.

EVM_PRIVATE_KEY.description: Fallback signer: 0x-prefixed 32-byte hex private key for the agent wallet on Base. Used only when no wallet backend service (for example @elizaos/plugin-wallet) is registered.
